Locate a bundled example Eprime file

Source: R/example_eprime_file.R
example_eprime_file.Rd

Locate a bundled example Eprime file

Usage

example_eprime_file(which)

Arguments

which

A short name or full filename identifying an example file. Omit which to print the available names and filenames.

Value

A filepath to the selected file. If which is missing, the named vector of available filenames is printed and returned invisibly.

Details

This function uses system.file() to locate files bundled with rprime. Available short names are Blending, MINP, MP, SAILS1, SAILS2, and not_an_eprime_file.

MP contains an interrupted experiment. not_an_eprime_file is a non-Eprime file used to demonstrate how read_eprime() handles such input.

Examples

example_eprime_file()
#>                  Blending                      MINP                        MP 
#>  "Blending_001L00XS4.txt"      "MINP_001L00XS1.txt" "MP_Block1_001P00XA1.txt" 
#>                    SAILS1                    SAILS2        not_an_eprime_file 
#>     "SAILS_001X00XS1.txt"     "SAILS_002X00XS1.txt"  "not_an_eprime_file.txt" 
example_eprime_file("MINP")
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/rprime/example-data/MINP_001L00XS1.txt"
example_eprime_file("MINP_001L00XS1.txt")
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/rprime/example-data/MINP_001L00XS1.txt"
read_eprime(example_eprime_file("SAILS1"))
